title: ZeroRun Harness 0.8.0: software and qualified native-evidence replay
description: Development deposit metadata for a bounded native-evidence utility with five Python/CLI operations, declarative C1-C3 relationships, versioned structural bindings, independent ordinary checks and source-distribution native qualification recipes. The software preserves separately archived application observations and distinguishes new native acquisition, retained replay and authored development controls. Exact executed native scope, failures and code identities belong to the accompanying qualification records.
notes: New code and authored records use MIT; the unmodified vendored PyContract core retains Apache-2.0 terms. Upstream datasets and candidate programs remain with their original publishers. This metadata file is a deposit preparation artifact and does not assert that a deposit or DOI exists.
